== Description ==

[[Scott Lingrell]] (left, black polo, khaki shorts, white hair, and glasses) playing [[Ming Huo]] (right, tan zip hoodie, blue shorts, and smartwatch) at a table in the hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
